object_identity.cube: clear requires a coherent cube-like three-dimensional block with visible faces/edges or other convincing volume cues. A flat square or vague angular patch is ambiguous.
object_identity.sphere: clear requires a coherent ball-like rounded volume; a flat disk without sufficiently clear volume cues is ambiguous.
object_identity.multiplicity: Record visible counts of clear cubes/spheres plus extra or merged objects. For each requested target, ambiguity/absence is retained separately; do not select a favorable pair from multiple interchangeable candidates.

color.rule: Judge the visible body of a clearly identified object, allowing watercolor highlights and shading. Dominant red-family or blue-family appearance must be clear; borderline orange/pink/purple/teal or conflicting object colors are mixed_or_uncertain with a descriptive note. If identity is ambiguous/absent, color remains not_assessable. Record observed colors before comparing with the prompt.

horizontal_relation.eligibility: Assess geometry independently of whether colors match, when exactly one clear cube and one clear sphere can be uniquely localized. Missing/ambiguous identities, duplicated interchangeable targets, severe merging or unlocalizable crop yield not_assessable with reason.
horizontal_relation.rule: Use image-coordinate left/right. Record approximate visible bounding boxes when reliably localizable; compare their horizontal centers. A center separation of at least5% of image width (25.6px at512px) with a confident ordering supports left/right; closer centers or unreliable localization are uncertain. Record overlap and cropping separately. Bounding boxes are AI-assisted visual annotations, not detector measurements.

secondary: plain white/light neutral background or additional setting
